type Split<S extends string, T extends string[] = []> = 
    S extends `${infer First}${infer Rest}` 
    ? [First, ...Split<Rest, T>]
    : T;


type Reverse<S extends string, Result extends string = ''> = 
    S extends `${infer First}${infer Rest}`
    ? `${Reverse<Rest>}${First}${Result}`
    : Result;


type GenerateArray<N extends number, Arr extends Array<number> = []> = 
    Arr['length'] extends N 
    ? Arr
    : GenerateArray<N, [1, ...Arr]>;
